pterodactyl.key: Your Pterodactyl API key with all permissions

website.secret: Default Secret (Change this to any string you want)

cluster._note: Number of worker processes to fork. Set to 0 to auto-detect based on available CPU cores (recommended).

api.code: Default API Key (Change this to any string you want)

joinguild._comment: The Discord bot must be in these servers and have invite permissions. Automatic guild joining will not work unless role packages are configured correctly. You can always just set it to a random role & package so that only this works.

giverole._comment: Auto-join must be enabled for this to work - or the user must already be in your Discord. This will give the user a role when they login.

passwordgenerator.note: Use this to disable registering on Nebulactyl.

oauth2._comment: Go to https://discord.dev/ and create an application to set up OAuth2. This is required for Nebulactyl to work. You must also set the redirect URL to the link below.

ip._note: Anti-alt checks will not work if you are proxying through Cloudflare. This is due to the fact that Cloudflare does not pass the real IP address through the headers. If you are using Cloudflare, please disable this feature.

rolePackages.note: This allows you to set a different plan/package to people who have a specific role however this requires the Discord bot to be configured and functioning. This is mainly used for Boost rewards.

earn._note: Configuration for the Nebulactyl coin-earning tasks (AFK page). Each task type has its own daily completion limit per user.

linkvertise._note: Set enabled to true once you've entered your real Linkvertise user ID below. Uses Linkvertise's public dynamic-link format: link-to.net/{userId}/.../dynamic?r={base64 callback}

linkpays._note: Set enabled to true once you've entered your real Linkpays credentials below. urlTemplate supports {userId} and {callback} (the callback is URL-encoded automatically) placeholders in case Linkpays' exact URL format differs from the default.

afk._note: This is the AFK coin-earning system. It gives the user coins every x seconds while they keep this page open.

ads._note: Ad banner shown ONLY on the AFK page. Paste your ad network's embed/HTML snippet (e.g. an AdSense <ins> ad unit) into 'code'. No popups or interstitials are used anywhere in Nebulactyl.

banner.code: <!-- Paste your ad network's banner embed code here (e.g. Google AdSense ad unit) -->

antivpn.note: For this to work, generate an API Key on https://proxycheck.io/. If you do not put a key, Nebulactyl will automatically disable anti-VPN.

whitelist.note: This allows only specific people to be able to login to the Nebulactyl dashboard. This does not affect your Panel.

logging._note: This is the Nebulactyl logging system. It posts events to a Discord webhook.
